title: Rust: bounded observed peer and service metrics
description:
Update CCP2 samplers in rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs and their authenticated RX/TX event hooks in rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs. Count distinct immediate peers with bounded storage and coverage information. Advance observation windows independently of RX, and separate TX airtime, observed busy time, CCA deferrals, queue service and directional delivery evidence. Remove synthetic RSSI/loss neighbors only from the CCP2 policy path.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: BusyPercentSampler, PeerDensityTracker and related trackers already exist. Reuse them as b7z9.29 foundations rather than file another missing-sampler fix. No new metrics framework, queue growth or feedback-controller tuning is required. Retain control-traffic density and adaptive-budget tiers without coupling them to remote channel/SF selection. Preserve baseline protocol/security, custody and identity ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Consume vectors.07 through production samplers and hooks. Test duplicate peers, relayed origins, idle many versus busy few, weak RSSI/loss without extra peers, off-channel coverage, no-RX aging, SFN/time wrap and bounded-table saturation with uncertainty retained. TX completion must not become a packet-delivery sample. Extend core RF-health unit/vector tests and focused node event tests. Run hosted tests plus core --no-default-features checks, fmt and clippy; preserve legacy fixtures.
